items.name: Finset.sum_card_le
items.type: {α : Type u_2} [DecidableEq α] {B : Finset (Finset α)} {n : ℕ} [Fintype α] (h : ∀ (a : α), {b ∈ B | a ∈ b}.card ≤ n) : ∑ s ∈ B, s.card ≤ Fintype.card α * n

items.name: Finset.sum_card_inter_le
items.type: {α : Type u_2} [DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} {B : Finset (Finset α)} {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ a ∈ s, {b ∈ B | a ∈ b}.card ≤ n) : ∑ t ∈ B, (s ∩ t).card ≤ s.card * n

items.name: Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → R) : (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2

items.name: Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_eq_mul
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι) {r f g : ι → R} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ g i) (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, r i ^ 2 = f i * g i) : (∑ i ∈ s, r i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i

items.name: Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι) {r f g : ι → R} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ g i) (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, r i ^ 2 ≤ f i * g i) : (∑ i ∈ s, r i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i

items.name: Real.sum_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le
items.type: {ι : Type u_2} {f g : ι → ℝ} (s : Finset ι) (hf : ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ f i) (hg : ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ g i) : ∑ i ∈ s, √(f i) * √(g i) ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i)

items.name: Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
items.type: {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ √(∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * √(∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)

items.name: NNReal.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
items.type: {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → NNReal) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i ≤ NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)

items.name: NNReal.sum_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le
items.type: {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → NNReal) : ∑ i ∈ s, NNReal.sqrt (f i) * NNReal.sqrt (g i) ≤ NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * NNReal.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, g i)

items.name: IsCauSeq.series_ratio_test
